description: Land Title Settlement Department - Settlement Orders No. 450 (Badulla) - Main Area in Binthenna,m Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Block Survey Topo Plan No. 57 (Uva)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically final orders for land settlement in Badulla District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels being settled to The State, including lot numbers, extents, and registration details. The content is primarily focused on land title settlement and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
